ns2:group.ns2:description:
万科第一次公开“求展期”，债券应声暴跌、这不是一次普通的资金紧张，而像是崩盘倒计时的开机画面。 深圳地铁一年出手12次、291.3亿借款“续命”，这次也救不动了吗？
这一集狗剩将带你从 2015-2017 的权力与资本暗战，一路追到2025 危机前夜：万科为什么从“财务优等生”走到今天？中国楼市的去杠杆周期，究竟有多残酷？
我为了做这期节目，采访了一位万科管理层，我们长谈了6小时。本期将借助他提供的独家视角，穿透财报迷雾，拆解万科资金链断裂的真实逻辑。
---
## 本期你会听到什么
2025危机前夜：20亿公司债到期、展期请求遭拒，为什么市场瞬间“用脚投票”？ 从“无实控人”到“国资入主”：王石当年“放弃控股权”到底是高明还是埋雷？ 宝万之争全复盘： 姚振华如何用险资高杠杆“举牌”万科？万科管理层为何要拉来“白衣骑士”深铁？ 深铁接盘的代价：分红对赌、治理结构变化、表面平静下的暗流涌动 看不见的灰色结构：“事业合伙人/盈安合伙”是激励机制，还是隐藏的利益通道？ 高杠杆的影子帝国：祝九胜、博商资管、表外融资平台如何让风险堆到“看不见的地方” 2020-2021转折点： “三道红线”之下，为什么万科看似绿档、却在利润端率先崩塌？
---
## 这集最关键的三个问题
1. 万科怎么了？ ——不是一天变坏，而是长期结构性缺陷叠加周期反转 2. 深铁为什么越救越深？ ——“输血”能续命，但也可能固化激励与风险偏好 3. 中国楼市怎么了？ ——土地财政、信用扩张、去杠杆的旧剧本，正在写下最后一幕

* 危机引爆：债券展期遭拒、评级跳水、违约预期升温 * 创业往事：王石与“股权异数” * 宝万之争：资本暗战、监管转向、深铁登场 * 深铁入主后：分红对赌、扩张冲动、治理与激励错位 * 影子结构：合伙人平台、表外资金与“影子万科” * 2020-2021：表面稳健与利润崩塌的反差

Though he and his company are still young, their inventions have already opened new markets, solved problems no one had solved before, and grown from challengers into new giants. Think Bold — not as a slogan, but as a way of seeing the world. He has the time to carry his wild ideas into more places, and the ability to find others whose inner sparks are quietly flickering — turning small impulses into vast joy. In this fifteenth episode of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, we talk with Insta360 founder JK Liu about entrepreneurship, invention, and the small thoughts that change everything.

In this video, we break down why Apple likely delayed the next Apple TV 4K and what we now expect in early 2026 instead. Reports suggest Apple is sticking with the same familiar Apple TV design, but under the hood, the upgrades could be significant. Rumors point to Apple’s new N1 wireless chip with Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread support, along with a major performance jump from the A15 Bionic to a potential A17 Pro chip.
If that happens, the next Apple TV could support faster streaming, lower latency gaming, and possibly even Apple Intelligence features tied to the next generation of Siri on tvOS. We also cover what’s coming next for the HomePod mini. A second-generation HomePod mini is expected to arrive alongside the new Apple TV, featuring a newer S-series chip for better performance and responsiveness, possible Ultra Wideband upgrades, and new color options. However, recent leaks suggest Apple may rely on MediaTek wireless chips instead of its own N1 for lower-cost devices like HomePod mini.
With Apple’s smart home ecosystem expanding in 2026 and major Siri upgrades on the horizon, this delay may be part of a much bigger plan.
